doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Billie Pierce: Pensacola, her wedding, bands and blues singers
summary: Billie Pierce talks about growing up in Pensacola, meeting De De, her wedding, New Orleans clubs and bandleaders, and playing with blues singers like Bessie Smith and Ida Cox.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
